formal_scope: The consensus convergence theorem for 0 < τ ≤ 943/500, the arbitrary-rank and full-rank affine-constraint theorems, the two finite-memory certificates up to 943/500 and the version 1.0 periodic orbit in R^128 for τ ≥ 1.8868954… are formalized in 168 Lean modules. The extension of convergence to 377359/200000 and the orbit for τ ≥ 1.8868840… rest on exact rational certificates and conventional proofs; the scalar theorem, individual objective-value limits, the reduction from proper closed convex functions to proximal attainment, and penalty rescaling are conventional.
